security_audit.summary: Static matches were adjudicated against the faceless video-production workflow. They are false positives caused mainly by JavaScript regular expressions, template literals, local relative references, and normal media-processing commands. No prompt injection, secret exfiltration, malicious persistence, or unauthorized network-data transfer was found. Static review was capped at 400/588 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 188 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The workflow permits an HF_MEDIA_ENGINE environment override for the shared audio engine.
remediation.suggestion: Document that this override must point to a trusted local engine and validate the resolved path before invoking it.

remediation.issue: Generated pages depend on a third-party GSAP CDN resource.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the version and integrity hash pinned, or bundle the dependency for fully offline and reproducible renders.

remediation.issue: Media assembly invokes ffprobe and ffmpeg.
remediation.suggestion: Continue using argument arrays and fixed executable names; document the required trusted media-tool installation.

content.value_statement: Written material is difficult to turn into a clear video plan. This skill creates a structured workflow for scripts, storyboards, visual scenes, captions, audio, and assembly.
actual_capabilities: Converts a topic, article, notes, or brief into an explainer video plan.
Creates a script and storyboard with frame durations and narrative structure.
Designs abstract visuals, typography, diagrams, data visuals, and motion cues per scene.
Builds frame compositions and assembles them into a standalone video page.
Generates or synchronizes narration timing, background music, sound effects, and captions.
Validates frame composition rules before final assembly.
limitations: It is designed for invented visuals, not website tours or screen-recording videos.
Final render quality depends on available fonts, media tools, and shared HyperFrames resources.
Audio generation requires a compatible local audio engine and any required provider access.
It does not guarantee factual accuracy of source material or rights to supplied content.

use_cases.title: Explain a technical concept
use_cases.description: Turn engineering notes into a concise visual explanation with diagrams, captions, and paced narration.

use_cases.title: Create a product education video
use_cases.description: Convert a product brief into a feature-focused explainer without recording a screen or filming footage.

use_cases.title: Publish a learning summary
use_cases.description: Transform an article or lesson outline into a structured video for an internal training audience.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: explain a topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second faceless explainer about how password managers work. Use a clear structure and simple visual ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: use source notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn supplied material into a video plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these notes into a 90-second faceless explainer. Create a script, storyboard, narration plan, and scene-by-scene visual direction: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: set brand direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a two-minute faceless explainer for operations leaders about reducing meeting load. Use a calm professional tone, dark blue and teal colors, kinetic typography, diagrams, captions, and light background music.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: request production constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a faceless explainer from this brief for a 16:9 video. Use eight frames, 75 seconds maximum, no narration, music set to none, accessible captions, and explicit motion cues: [paste brief].

output_examples.input: Create a 60-second explainer about password managers.
output: A concise hook that names the password reuse problem.
A storyboard that shows vaults, encryption, and autofill with abstract diagrams.
A narration and caption plan aligned to frame durations.

output_examples.input: Turn these product notes into a training video.
output: A frame-by-frame lesson structure with learning objectives.
Visual directions for typography, icons, diagrams, and scene motion.
An assembled composition plan with optional narration, music, and sound effects.

best_practices: Provide a clear audience, goal, runtime, and format before production begins.
Use source material that has been checked for accuracy and usage rights.
Review the storyboard and visual plan before generating or assembling final frames.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for a website tour or screen-recording video.
Do not request visual claims that the source material cannot support.
Do not skip review of narration timing, captions, and final render output.

faq.question: What type of video does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates faceless explainers using designed visuals, typography, diagrams, captions, and optional audio.

faq.question: Can it use an article as input?
faq.answer: Yes. It can turn an article, notes, topic, or brief into a structured explainer workflow.

faq.question: Does it record a website?
faq.answer: No. Use a product-tour workflow when the video must capture or demonstrate a website.

faq.question: Can I control narration and music?
faq.answer: Yes. You can specify a voice, playback speed, music direction, sound effects, or a silent video.

faq.question: What files does the workflow produce?
faq.answer: The workflow plans scripts and storyboards, builds frame compositions, and assembles a standalone video page.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing?
faq.answer: Review factual accuracy, rights to supplied material, captions, audio timing, branding, and the final render.
